morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动式，词根 rogol 的首音 /r/ 保留，无鼻音同化。输入包将 dirogol 判为词根有误。

senses.zh_definition: 遭到强奸；被他人强迫发生性交。
senses.en_definition: To be raped; to be subjected to forced sexual intercourse.
senses.nuances: merogol 的被动式，主语为遭受侵害者；di- 本身不表示过去时。不可泛指所有形式的性骚扰或性侵害。此处马来语释义依据词根释义改写为被动式，非另立词条的逐字引文。参见 [DBP：rogol](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=rogol)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Menurut laporan polis, mangsa dipercayai dirogol oleh seorang lelaki yang dikenalinya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 根据警方报告，受害者据信遭到一名认识的男子强奸。
dual_scenarios.en: According to the police report, the victim is believed to have been raped by a man she knew.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia beritahu aku yang dia dirogol. Aku nak teman dia kalau dia perlukan bantuan.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dia memberitahu saya bahawa dia dirogol. Saya mahu menemaninya jika dia memerlukan bantuan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 她告诉我，她被强奸了。要是她需要帮助，我想陪着她。
dual_scenarios.en: She told me she was raped. I want to be there for her if she needs help.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, dengar dulu apa yang dia nak. Jangan paksa dia cerita, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dengar dahulu apa yang dia mahu. Jangan memaksanya menceritakan kejadian itu.

etymology.historical_story: The recoverable formation here is grammatical: Malay adds the passive prefix di- to rogol. This shifts attention from the perpetrator to the person subjected to the assault. DBP records the related forms merogol, perogol and perogolan. The consulted entry does not establish a deeper historical origin for rogol, so no speculative borrowing story is assigned.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认 di-＝被，再认 rogol＝强奸：dirogol 就是遭到强奸。用语法记忆，避免戏谑谐音。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是严肃而直接的侵害用语，不属于粗口。与当事人交谈时应尊重其自述和称谓，避免追问细节、质疑经历或归咎受害者。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于准确叙述、新闻报道及支持性交流。转述未经证实的指控时须保留原有的 didakwa、dipercayai 等限定，避免公开可识别当事人的信息，也不宜将此词用作玩笑或夸张比喻。
